entities.name: Nitrile reduction to aminomethyl
observations: The encoded transformation converts a nitrile group (C#N) into a primary aminomethyl group (CH2NH2) while retaining the methylamino and ether/aryl motifs.
Reaction substrate/product correspond to CNC(C#N)COCc1ccccc1 → CNC(CN)COCc1ccccc1.

entities.name: DIBAL-H
observations: Diisobutylaluminum hydride is the reagent in the exact ORD-matched precedent for this nitrile-to-primary-amine transformation.
The retrieved precedent represents DIBAL-H as CC(C)[CH2][AlH][CH2]C(C)C; toluene is the associated solvent/additional component.
